audit_evidence.note: The delegation context carried the Component 4b reconciliation as prose, not as the verbatim NDJSON the gate consumes, and the second proposal's emitted audit id (core_docs_correctness_and_dedup_audit) did not match its final project_name (core_docs_correctness_and_single_authority_audit). state-write.sh's audit-evidence gate requires exact .proposal.id == project_name equality. Rather than rename either side or hand-fabricate a verdict document, the audit was re-run read-only via .claude/scripts/audit-task-proposals.sh with --id set to each final project_name, which is the documented caller contract. Both proposals returned passes.mechanical=true and passes.semantic=true at exit 0, and the real verdict objects are now recorded verbatim on each entry's audit_verdict field.
